sources.name: Refund FAQ
sources.content:
Q: How long do refunds take?
A: Approved refunds are returned to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

Q: Can I get a refund after 30 days?
A: No. Refund requests must be made within 30 days of delivery. After that we can offer store credit for unused items.

Q: Are shipping fees refunded?
A: Original shipping fees are refunded only if the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.

sources.name: Shipping policy
sources.content:
We ship within the Philippines, Singapore, and Japan. Orders placed before 2 PM Manila time ship the same business day.

Metro Manila deliveries arrive in 1 to 2 business days. Visayas and Mindanao deliveries, including Cebu and Davao, take 3 to 5 business days. Singapore and Japan take 5 to 8 business days.

Shipping is free for orders over 2,500 pesos within the Philippines. You can change the delivery address until the order is packed; after that, contact us and we will try to reroute it with the courier.

sources.name: Returns and exchanges
sources.content:
Q: Can I exchange an item for a different size?
A: Yes. Exchanges for a different size or color are free within 30 days, as long as the item is unworn and has its tags.

Q: My item arrived damaged. What do I do?
A: Send a photo of the damage within 7 days of delivery. We will send a replacement at no cost, or a full refund if it is out of stock.

Q: Can I return sale items?
A: Sale items marked final sale cannot be returned or exchanged.

sources.name: Product care guide
sources.content:
Our waxed canvas jackets should not be machine washed. Spot clean with cold water and a soft brush, and re-wax once a season to keep them water resistant.

Merino wool base layers can be machine washed on a cold wool cycle and laid flat to dry. Do not tumble dry merino, as it will shrink.

All leather boots come with a one-year warranty against stitching and sole defects. The warranty does not cover normal wear or water damage from not conditioning the leather.

sources.name: Payments and discounts
sources.content:
Q: What payment methods do you accept?
A: We accept Visa, Mastercard, GCash, Maya, and cash on delivery within Metro Manila.

Q: Do you have a student discount?
A: Yes. Students get 10% off full-price items after verifying a valid school ID at checkout.

Q: Can I use two discount codes on one order?
A: No. Only one discount code can be applied per order.
